note: P has a lens cloud held over a windy ridge, an amber-to-blue afterglow with stars, and two near-identical nacreous-cloud-at-sunset poems (P3 and P4 share the ridge, the mother-of-pearl edge and the fade to blue or grey). Q is more concentrated: Q2, Q3 and Q4 all lean on nacreous or mother-of-pearl light, and Q1, Q2 and Q4 end on the same unseen or gone-by-dawn beat, with only Q1 (silver threads, noctilucent-style) and Q3 (an unnamed cloud past a mountain) clearly separate.
